verdict.rationale: Unreal offers full source-code access under its EULA and can be built/run locally (compiled via Visual Studio/XCode, packaged/deployed via UAT/UBT), which supports a form of self-hosting the core engine. However, this is source-available under a revenue-share EULA, not a freely self-hostable open-source deployment, and the repo itself is account/EULA-gated (GitHub API returns 'Not Found' without access) — missing for 10: fully open self-hosting without EULA/account gating, no evidence of containerized/server self-hosted deployment model, and no independent confirmation of ease of self-hosting outside Epic's own docs.
